documents.title: ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development
documents.abstract: We propose ChatDev, a virtual chat-powered software development company that operates through multiple agents holding different roles. Through collaborative dialogue, they complete the software development lifecycle.

documents.title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
documents.abstract: MetaGPT encodes Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) into prompts to enhance multi-agent collaboration in software engineering, significantly reducing logic errors in code generation.

documents.title: AutoCoder: Autonomous Code Generation via Multi-Agent Debate
documents.abstract: AutoCoder utilizes a dual-agent system with a generator and a reviewer. They debate over logical flaws in the generated Python code, leading to state-of-the-art results on HumanEval.

documents.title: Agentic Code Review Automation
documents.abstract: We introduce a specialized LLM agent designed exclusively for GitHub Pull Request reviews. It analyzes code diffs, identifies security vulnerabilities, and suggests automated fixes.

documents.title: Self-Debugging Agents with Execution Feedback
documents.abstract: A framework where coding agents execute their output in a secure sandbox, parse the runtime errors, and iteratively refine the code without human intervention.

documents.title: Collaborative Bug Fixing Swarm
documents.abstract: Deploying a micro-swarm of specific-role agents (e.g., Syntax Checker, Memory Profiler, Logic Tester) to concurrently isolate and fix bugs in legacy enterprise codebases.

documents.title: Executable Agentic Workflows for Database Management
documents.abstract: This study explores autonomous agents for SQL database administration. The agent executes queries, reads schemas, and rolls back transactions, achieving zero-shot database optimization.

documents.title: LLM for Query Plan Optimization
documents.abstract: We present an agentic approach to PostgreSQL query optimization. The agent interacts with the query planner, observes execution costs, and automatically generates optimal indexing strategies.

documents.title: Autonomous DBA: Managing Databases with LLMs
documents.abstract: An end-to-end multi-agent framework acting as a Database Administrator. It handles routine tasks like backup scheduling, anomaly detection, and capacity scaling.

documents.title: Zero-shot Database Tuning Agent
documents.abstract: By leveraging a reinforcement learning environment linked to an LLM, our agent tunes database knob configurations in real-time under varying workload conditions.

documents.title: Multi-Agent Data Warehouse Management
documents.abstract: A decentralized agent system where each agent is responsible for a specific ETL pipeline within a Snowflake data warehouse, autonomously handling data quality alerts.

documents.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
documents.abstract: We introduce Toolformer, a model trained to decide which APIs to call, when to call them, and how to parse the results, integrating search engines and calculators natively.

documents.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
documents.abstract: WebArena provides a simulated web environment for agents to perform tasks like booking flights or managing e-commerce backends using browser interactions.

documents.title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
documents.abstract: Gorilla is an LLM finetuned to write API calls for AWS, GCP, and Hugging Face services, significantly reducing hallucinated arguments via document retrieval.

documents.title: BrowserGym: Training Agents to Surf the Web
documents.abstract: An open-source gym environment evaluating multimodal agents on complex web browsing tasks, requiring planning, clicking, and form filling.

documents.title: Agentic RAG: Beyond Simple Retrieval
documents.abstract: We upgrade standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation by introducing an agent that autonomously formulates multiple sub-queries, evaluates retrieved context, and decides when to stop searching.

documents.title: Multi-modal Web Agent with Visual Grounding
documents.abstract: An agent utilizing both HTML DOM structure and visual screenshots to navigate modern Javascript-heavy web applications with high precision.

documents.title: Self-Reflective Tool-Use Agents
documents.abstract: Agents that not only call external APIs but also reflect on API error codes (e.g., 400 Bad Request) to autonomously correct parameter payloads.

documents.title: ChemAgent: Autonomous Chemical Synthesis Planning
documents.abstract: An LLM-driven agent capable of reading chemical literature, planning retrosynthesis pathways, and directly controlling robotic lab equipment for synthesis.

documents.title: BioCoder: An Agent for Bioinformatics Pipelines
documents.abstract: BioCoder acts as a bioinformatics assistant, chaining together tools like BLAST, ClustalW, and specialized Python scripts to analyze genomic sequences autonomously.

documents.title: Agentic Workflows in Drug Discovery
documents.abstract: Deploying multi-agent systems to evaluate molecular docking scores, predict toxicity, and filter candidate compounds for pre-clinical trials.

documents.title: Autonomous Lab Agent for Materials Science
documents.abstract: A closed-loop system where an AI agent designs experiment parameters, triggers physical characterization tools, and updates its scientific hypothesis based on the results.

documents.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration for Medical Diagnosis
documents.abstract: A framework involving specialized medical agents (e.g., Radiologist Agent, Pathologist Agent) that debate over patient cases to reach a consensus diagnosis, reducing misdiagnosis rates.

documents.title: Swarm Intelligence in Large Language Models
documents.abstract: Exploring how connecting dozens of small-parameter LLM agents can result in emergent problem-solving capabilities that rival monolithic massive models.

documents.title: Consensus Voting Algorithms for AI Agents
documents.abstract: A mathematical framework for handling disagreements among LLM agents in a multi-agent debate, ensuring Byzantine fault tolerance in AI decision-making.

documents.title: Massive Multi-Agent Swarms for Automated Data Annotation
documents.abstract: Deploying swarms of thousands of micro-agents, each assigned a micro-task, to collaboratively label and verify massive datasets, reducing annotation costs by 90%.

documents.title: Decentralized Agent Networks for Distributed Computing
documents.abstract: Routing complex computational tasks across a decentralized network of independent AI agents, utilizing blockchain smart contracts for task verification.

documents.title: Large Scale Agent Simulation for Economic Policy
documents.abstract: Simulating macroeconomic policies by deploying millions of LLM agents, each acting as a consumer with distinct personas, to predict market inflation trends.

documents.title: Byzantine Fault Tolerant Swarm Agents
documents.abstract: Enhancing the security of massive multi-agent swarms by introducing cryptographic voting mechanisms, preventing malicious agents from corrupting the swarm's consensus.

documents.title: A Survey on Large Language Models
documents.abstract: A comprehensive review of the evolution of large language models, their architectures, training methodologies, and future directions.

documents.title: Advances in Quantum Computing
documents.abstract: This paper discusses the recent hardware breakthroughs in quantum computing, focusing on superconducting qubits and error correction codes.

documents.title: Global Warming and Ocean Currents
documents.abstract: An analysis of how rising global temperatures are affecting the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC).
